soldier: Head of the soldier orange-yellow, thorax and abdomen pale yellow, pilosity sparse throughout. Head oval, 1.33–1.49 times as long as wide, very slightly raised in profile. Labrum lanceolate, about 1.14–1.49 times as long as wide, the semi-transparent area narrow and rounded-projecting. Mandibles 0.64–0.72 times head capsule length, apex slender and straight. Margin of the lacinia with about 10 setae. Postmentum slightly broad. Antennae 14–15 segments. Pronotum 1.59–1.69 times as wide as long, the anterior incision deeper than the posterior one.
taxonomy_note: The species was placed in Tsaitermes in the original work; it is here placed in Reticulitermes.
